sql: select (select extra_instructions from public.ai_agent_settings where company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') as info, (select string_agg(x.scenario_key || ' >> ' || (select string_agg('[' || (e->>'turn') || '] ' || (e->>'who') || ': ' || left(replace(e->>'text', E'\n', ' '), case when e->>'who' = 'ferramenta' then 350 else 500 end), ' ## ') from jsonb_array_elements(x.transcript) e where coalesce(e->>'kind','text') in ('text') or e->>'who' = 'ferramenta'), ' @@@@ ') from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = (select id from public.ai_sim_runs order by created_at desc limit 1) and x.scenario_key in ('remarcar_visita','empresa')) as t
